name: @odh-dashboard/dashboard-dist-full
description: Full RHOAI/ODH dashboard assembler — uses app-shell which delegates to the real frontend code

scripts.start:dev:backend: ASSEMBLER_DIR=$PWD NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 NODE_ENV=development APP_ENV=development npm run start:dev --prefix ../dashboard-shell-backend
scripts.test:cypress-ci: npx concurrently -P -k -s first "npm run cypress:server:build && npm run cypress:server" "npm run cypress:server:wait && npm run cypress:run:mock -- {@}" --
scripts.test:cypress-ci:coverage: npx concurrently -P -k -s first "npm run cypress:server:build:coverage && npm run cypress:server" "npm run cypress:server:wait && npm run cypress:run:mock:coverage -- {@}" --
scripts.test:cypress-ci:coverage:nobuild: npx concurrently -P -k -s first 'npm run cypress:server' 'npm run cypress:server:wait && npm run cypress:run:mock:coverage -- {@}' --
scripts.coverage:merge: rimraf coverage && istanbul-merge --out coverage/coverage-final.json jest-coverage/coverage-final.json ../cypress/coverage/coverage-final.json && nyc report --reporter html -t coverage --report-dir coverage/report && nyc report --reporter json-summary -t coverage --report-dir coverage
scripts.cypress:server:build: cross-env MF_DEV=true ODH_DIST_DIR=./public-cypress POLL_INTERVAL=9999999 FAST_POLL_INTERVAL=9999999 WS_HOSTNAME=localhost:9002 npm run build
scripts.cypress:server:dev: cross-env POLL_INTERVAL=9999999 FAST_POLL_INTERVAL=9999999 ODH_PORT=9001 WS_HOSTNAME=localhost:9002 npm run start:dev
scripts.cypress:open:mock: cross-env CY_MOCK=1 CY_WS_PORT=9002 npm run cypress:open --
scripts.cypress:run:mock: cross-env CY_MOCK=1 CY_WS_PORT=9002 npm run cypress:run --
scripts.cypress:run:mock:coverage: rimraf ../cypress/coverage ../cypress/.nyc_output && cross-env CY_COVERAGE=true npm run cypress:run:mock -- {@}
scripts.cypress:run:record: cross-env CY_RECORD=1 npm run cypress:run && npm run cypress:format
